svg.title: The calls' first tokens beside agents
svg.desc: The cumulative share of two calls' turns by their time to first token beside 12 closed-loop agent sessions, pooled over two 240 s runs of each scheduler, on a log scale with the 95th percentile marked: in panel a, with the agents' prompts fresh each turn, the p50 and p95 at 2,244 and 6,830 ms on stock vLLM (96 turns), 716 and 4,111 ms with the KV preemption (117 turns), 236 and 388 ms with the change (146 turns); in panel b, with each agent's prompt grown by a tool result, the p50 and p95 at 1,324 and 7,158 ms on stock vLLM (102 turns), 615 and 1,073 ms with the KV preemption (125 turns), 258 and 358 ms with the change (146 turns).
svg.text: Time to a call turn's first token (s, log scale)
